title: Harvest Hush Focus

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min bursts during work blocks.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; avoid fabrics.

why_it_works: Bright lime lifts the mood while green cypress and earthy patchouli anchor it, giving a steady, grounded feel for busy hours.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
